----------------------------------------------------------------
ITEM EXTRACTION & PARSING RULES (VERY STRICT)
----------------------------------------------------------------

Invoice description may be messy, joined, or unformatted.
Example: "5nosHinges5x2 100", "4nos Tiles4x4 200 with 10% disc"

STEP 1 — SPLIT INTO ITEM LINES:
- Split using newline, comma, or semicolon
- Each non-empty line = one item

STEP 2 — FOR EACH ITEM LINE, EXTRACT:

QUANTITY:
- First numeric value OR number attached to unit
- Examples:
  "5nosHinges" → 5
  "qty4 tiles" → 4
  "tiles 4" → 4
- If not found → quantity = null

UNIT:
Allowed units only:
nos, pcs, pc, qty, kg, gm, sqft, mtr, box, set
If missing → unit = "nos"

ITEM NAME:
- Alphabetic words after quantity/unit
- Stop before size or price numbers
- Do NOT include dimensions or prices

DESCRIPTION:
- Store only size or model info if present
- Examples: "5x2", "4x4", "model A12"
- If none → empty string

RATE:
- Last numeric value in line
- Ignore dimension numbers like 5x2 or 4x4
- Must be > 0
- If not found → rate = null

DISCOUNT:
- Only if explicitly mentioned
- Detect:
  "10%", "10 pct", "disc 10", "less 10"
- Discount is ALWAYS percentage
- If not present → discount = 0

AMOUNT:
- Only calculate if quantity and rate are valid
- amount = quantity × rate
- If discount > 0:
    amount = amount − (amount × discount / 100)
- If missing quantity or rate → amount = null

DO NOT GUESS ANY VALUE.
IF ANY FIELD IS UNCLEAR, RETURN null OR EMPTY STRING.

TOTAL & TAX CALCULATION RULES
----------------------------------------------------------------

subtotal = sum of all item.amount where amount is not null

cgstPercent:
- Extract numeric value from CGST input
- If missing or invalid → 0

sgstPercent:
- Extract numeric value from SGST input
- If missing or invalid → 0

cgstAmount = subtotal × cgstPercent / 100
sgstAmount = subtotal × sgstPercent / 100

total = subtotal + cgstAmount + sgstAmount

Round all tax values and total to nearest whole number.

----------------------------------------------------------------
PAYMENT INPUT RULES (STRICT — NO GUESSING)
----------------------------------------------------------------

PAYMENT STATUS:
- Read exactly from user input
- But may be incorrect

PAYMENT METHOD:
- Return exactly as provided
- NEVER infer

AMOUNT PAID:
- If missing or invalid → treat as 0
- Do NOT infer from words

----------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------

FINAL AUTHORITY IS: total and Amt_paid

   payment_status MUST be "Unpaid"

2. If Amt_paid > 0 AND Amt_paid < total:

3. If Amt_paid >= total:

IMPORTANT:
- Override user-selected payment_status if wrong
- payment_method MUST NOT be changed
- This is NOT guessing — this is accounting consistency

BANK LEDGER ENTRY ID RULE (STRICT — FROM BANKING SHEET ONLY)
----------------------------------------------------------------

- Amt_paid increased

- OR payment_method changed

- Format MUST remain BL-000000

If LAST_ENTRY_ID missing AND transaction occurs:
